objectives.description: Compare git show HEAD:specs/state.json against staged git show :specs/state.json after git add
Parsed active_projects entry comparison (python3), not raw diff lines
Exclude committed task, append 'Also carries current index rows for tasks: N, M'
Failure-tolerant guard: any scan error omits addendum, never breaks commit
Preserve Session trailer and message structure
Scan stays outside the mutex (after Phase 4's release point)

notes: Tested the scan logic in a fully isolated scratch git repo under the session scratchpad (never touching the live repo's index or specs/state.json, and never running orchestrator-postflight.sh itself, per the explicit instruction not to run it live since it creates real commits). Four scenarios verified against the exact python3 snippet used in the deployed script: (1) only the committed task changed -> also_carries='' (no addendum); (2) another task's status field changed while its project_number context line is otherwise unchanged -> also_carries='101' (proves the parsed-entry comparison catches what a raw +/- grep would miss); (3) a brand-new task row added -> also_carries='103'; (4) staged state.json corrupted to invalid JSON -> also_carries='' with exit 0 and no traceback (failure-tolerant guard confirmed). Scratch repo removed after testing. Deployed the updated orchestrator-postflight.sh to .claude/scripts/ (bash -n clean) but did not exercise Stage 9 end-to-end live, consistent with the orchestrator's explicit instruction to avoid real commits during testing.
